name: Helheim
legendaryAbilityText: You may treat this system as adjacent to the active system for the purposes of declaring and resolving retreats.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: Follow the beacon in disaster, like a hound that scents its master.
flavourText: A large elliptical orbit keeps this planet dark and hard to pin-point for long periods of time, but it can always be found with an access code to its signature beacon.
